description: UI profile for ourui's SIM build: EMPTY after the scenario reconciliation (sim/reports/v6.5-scenarios/RECONCILE.md). The scenario files now assert ourui's guarded behaviour directly (Meraki+ v6.4+: act_guard, frame policy, locked rows, brightness min 1, layout hook, corrected replay window), so the raw UI suite is green without overrides. The override mechanism in run_e2e.py is unchanged and backward-compatible (--ui-profile <file> can still point to e.g. the historical artifacts/ourui/sim_ui_profile.json from v6.4 — it does not match the reconciled scenarios, though, and will fail per override). The reference client's oracle behaviour lives in sim/sim_ui_profile-ref.json.
